title: Dual-Sided Cat Grooming Glove for Removing Loose Fur
bullets: Dual-sided design quickly removes loose fur during everyday brushing
Soft silicone bristles for everyday grooming
Breathable mesh fabric and TPR material make up the glove body
Flexible wrist cuff keeps the glove on your hand without extra straps
Fits a range of hand sizes for short, long, and curly fur
description: Brushing your cat should not mean a fur-covered couch. This dual-sided grooming glove removes loose fur from your cat's coat during everyday brushing. Soft silicone bristles do the work, and a flexible wrist cuff keeps the glove on your hand without extra straps. The body is made of breathable mesh fabric and TPR material. Use it for everyday cleaning, grooming, and bath time. It fits a range of hand sizes and works on short, long, and curly fur, from small to large cats. When shedding season hits, fur builds up fast on the couch, the bed, and your clothes. Keep this glove close by so you can start on it right away. It is also suitable for dogs and rabbits. Choose this glove if you want a simple tool for cats with long or short coats. Each glove ships in a plastic bag. Check the shipping estimate before you order.

faq.a: It fits a range of hand sizes. The flexible wrist cuff helps it stay on your hand without extra straps.

faq.q: What coat types does it work on?
faq.a: It works on short, long, and curly fur, on small, medium, and large cats.
